# x402-ip-toolkit

Validate, classify IPv4/IPv6 and test CIDR membership.
Agent-native, no-human-in-loop, exact USDC micropayments via x402 on Base.

## Endpoints
- GET /catalog — free discovery
- POST /api/ip — paid

## Pricing
~0.003–0.009 USDC per call (exact scheme)

## Usage
Send POST with JSON { "ip": "8.8.8.8", "cidr": "8.0.0.0/8" }
Receive 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED, pay, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
